issues_detected.description: known_limitations:5 self-discloses that no formal re-identification impact analysis has been conducted beyond HIPAA Safe Harbor. The de-identification approach is documented and appropriate for biometric voice data, but the residual re-identification risk is acknowledged rather than quantified.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add a documented re-identification risk assessment (e.g., k-anonymity or motivated-intruder analysis) for the feature-only public release to complement the HIPAA Safe Harbor claim.

issues_detected.description: BIDS v1.9.0 schema conformance is stated repeatedly in prose (distributions, raw_data_sources, preprocessing_strategies) but there is no structured conforms_to / conforms_to_schema field to make the standardization machine-readable.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate a conforms_to / conforms_to_schema field referencing the BIDS v1.9.0 specification URL so interoperability is captured as structured metadata, not only narrative text.

semantic_insights: PhysioNet DOI prefix (10.13026) is correctly used for the primary dataset DOI 10.13026/37yb-1t42

NIH grant number R01EB030362 (NIBIB, EB = biomedical imaging/bioengineering) correctly matches the PhysioNet distribution-infrastructure funder
HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification with exclusion of raw audio (biometric identifier under HIPAA) to controlled access is an appropriate method for biometric voice + health data
Temporal ordering is consistent: collection Sept 2022 to Nov 2026, first release late 2024, v1.0 Jan 2025 (306 participants), v3.0.0 2025 (833 participants), target 10,000 by 2027

Cross-field ethics consistency holds: involves_human_subjects=true is matched by ethical_reviews (USF Single IRB), informed_consent, at_risk_populations (pediatric), and Certificate of Confidentiality
Rich subpopulation characterization (6 cohorts) with clinical validation methods (laryngoscopy, MRI/CT, genome sequencing, spirometry) supports the human-subject representation claims

weaknesses: BIDS v1.9.0 conformance is stated only in prose; no structured conforms_to/conforms_to_schema field or explicit encoding declaration

Add a formal citation field with the dataset's recommended citation and DOI to complement external_resources
